observations: Black lens with 'YONGNUO' branding clearly visible on the barrel in photos 0, 1 and 2.
Front element cap also shows 'YONGNUO' text, mirrored, in photo 2.
A watermark ('POSTED ON JIJI ABBEY') overlays the lower barrel text in all three photos, obscuring the exact focal-length/aperture engraving (e.g. 'YN85mm f1.8').
Photo 2 shows the lens mounted on a camera body with a camouflage-pattern skin; brand/model of that body is not legible.
Two small black rectangular objects (possibly batteries or battery grips) sit on the table in photos 1 and 2; no markings are readable.
No lens mount contacts, rear bayonet, or any Nikon logo are visible in any photo.
No scratches, fungus, or dust are clearly visible on the front glass, but image resolution and angle don't rule them out.
